data.action: 躺椅上递防晒霜别脸傲娇，肩头微红发梢滴水
data.camera: medium shot, lounging under parasol, pool sparkle, tsundere mood
data.description: 【避暑山庄泳池·午后】白色的泳装连衣裙下是精心挑选的素雅比基尼，辉夜坐在遮阳伞下的躺椅上，把防晒霜递给你的时候别着脸——「泳、泳装有什么好看的……但是晒伤了就失礼了，所以……勉为其难让你涂吧。」白皙的肩膀在阳光下泛着微红，折叠马尾的发梢滴着水珠，大小姐的第一次度假笨拙又可爱。
data.lighting: 炽白阳光与泳池水光反射
data.promptProse: Kaguya Shinomiya sits on the shaded pool lounge chair in her white cotton summer dress with navy ribbon, extending a sunscreen bottle toward her companion while looking shyly aside. Drops remain at the ends of her folded black ponytail. The medium view includes the parasol support and bright pool behind. Strong afternoon sunlight lights the chair's uncovered edge, while blue water reflections shift beneath the parasol's soft shadow on her sleeves.
data.title: 四宫辉夜 · 泳池畔的千金休暇·「泳装有什么好看的，哼」
